I want a CRM for my recruitment agency. My contacts are either prospects, clients, or candidates for a recruitment campaign assigned by a client. Candidates go through a multi-step process (first contact or spontaneous application, screening against the role, background checks, first meeting, selection or rejection for the campaign, proposal to the client, then acceptance or rejection by the client, and finally successful hire after the trial period for billing). Candidates I've met for one role can be reused for another, so I need the history of roles I've proposed each candidate for. My company has 2 recruiters who share the candidate database. We mostly recruit technical profiles (developer, machine learning engineer, CTO, infra lead, lead developer, etc.) but occasionally we recruit Product Owners or team managers.

I want a tool to manage my art teaching activity. I have students and sessions (a session can have up to 15 students). I often overbook by 2 students to compensate for cancellations. Sessions are scheduled several weeks in advance, and I want students to be able to log into a form where they can book the slots they want, within the limits of their subscription (they typically subscribe to 20 sessions per year). I also accept people who come for a single session, and free trial sessions. I also need to allow cancellations. At the end of each month I need a recap of the number of sessions completed per person, and the number of pre-purchased sessions remaining. No need to manage venues, I only have one. I also need to be able to add notes per person to keep track of their specific needs over time.

I want to manage targeted communication campaigns. Launch email / SMS campaigns for batches of contacts by connecting to Brevo. Create and track call campaigns: I need to be able to add batches of contacts matching specific filters, then track the progress of my call campaign. I want to be able to call in one click using my IPBX and write a note during the call. I need to be able to record the success or failure of each call (answered? not answered? voicemail? not assigned? wrong person?). I must be able to track campaign progress (which calls have been made and which haven't). I'd also like to be able to recreate a call campaign from the calls that didn't succeed (no answer). Nice to have: I'd like to be able to split a campaign into sub-groups / columns, so I can assign several agents to it (each agent takes one column).

I have an IPBX and I'd like to do screen pops with the contact and CRM information. I can configure my IPBX to open a URL with the parameters call=ingoing or call=outgoing, and callnum={phone number}. I'd like a page that's called with these parameters and shows me the contact(s) matching the number (which can be in international format with 0033, +33 or in national format starting with 0, like 01, 02, 03, 04, 06, 07, 09…). I need to be able to fill in a note with the call content, marked as an incoming call. Nice to have: show the date of the last call in the contact details on the right side of the contact page.

I run LocaForce, a small equipment rental company. Our brand uses bold orange (#F97316) and dark charcoal (#1C1C1E) with a Montserrat font — sturdy and industrial. My fleet includes tools and machinery I rent to individuals and construction companies (scaffolding, compressors, concrete mixers, aerial lifts, etc.). Each piece of equipment has its own record: category, model, serial number, current status (available, rented, under maintenance, decommissioned), total usage hours, and purchase date. Rentals are the core of my business: a rental links a client to one or more pieces of equipment, with a start date, expected return date, actual return date, daily/weekly rate, deposit amount, and return condition. When equipment comes back damaged or reaches a maintenance threshold (by usage hours or scheduled interval), I create a maintenance job: description of work needed, parts replaced, cost, and a status (pending → in progress → done). On the dashboard I need equipment availability by category, active rentals overdue for return, and equipment currently blocked for maintenance. A client's profile should show their full rental history and any damage incidents they caused — I also want to flag clients who have caused damage before.

I'm a vet at Clinique Vétérinaire du Moulin, a small two-vet practice. Our visual identity uses sage green (#4CAF7D) and off-white (#F9F9F7) with a rounded Inter font — approachable and reassuring. My clients are pet owners, but the medical record belongs to the animal, not the owner. Each owner can have multiple animals (species, breed, name, date of birth, weight, microchip number). I track consultations per animal: date, reason for visit, diagnosis, treatment prescribed, and next appointment. I also need vaccination tracking — each vaccine has a validity period and I want automatic reminders for upcoming or overdue vaccinations. On the dashboard I want to see animals due for a vaccine in the next 30 days, and animals with a scheduled appointment this week. I use the existing notes feature for general client comments, but everything clinical should be organised around the animal. No billing needed, just the medical and appointment side.
